regions.merged_text: Incidently, I am not sure if I ever showed that photo. Ic case of neglect on my part heretofore, please remind me when you come the next time and I shall be pleased, as I am sure you will be. Please pardon if this is getting too drawn-out. I'll try and cach you before you leave for the North. God bless you again and I want you to bring me something about the conversion of that manager of yours down ther - or of one nearer the ideal.
